stable.headline: One part can wear several colours, STEP files open the way Cinema 4D shows them, and Photo mode draws the model for pictures.
notes: One part can wear several colours: pick polygons in Edit mesh and press Colour; files from other programs come in the same way.
STEP files open like Cinema 4D: even strips on fillets, a Clean quality, and CAD edit to pick whole CAD faces.
Remove holes, Untriangulate, Simplify round faces, Remove fillets and Remove lettering read the CAD faces of a STEP.
Photo mode, five photographed environments and a shorter Scene card.
Close open edges, Untriangulate into quads, and a Decimate that keeps the shape closer.
214 fixes: models from Blender open upright at real size, textures and UVs survive the tools, undo is sounder.
